meta.title: Office magic box
meta.description: Adds an Office magic box panel at the foot of the left sidebar with entries for small office tools. Launch console: register each local service, system, or script once with a name, command line, and working directory, then start, restart, stop, and read its output; group several into a scene and Start scene runs them in order, while Stop this group stops what that scene started. Invoice merge: pick several invoice PDFs (reorder as needed) and every generated page is previewed live; Print opens the system print dialog to pick a printer (duplex, flip on long edge), and Generate print file exports one PDF with two invoices per A4 side; layout can be auto, side by side, or stacked, paper can be A4 portrait or landscape, and a cut line can be drawn between the two. The home page shows the current version, and Settings changes the launch console state-file location plus the default invoice folder to open and the default save folder. Both tools run on this machine: invoice files never leave it, and service registrations live in a state file under the DSH home directory. Commands run with your own permissions, exactly as if typed in a terminal, and processes started from the panel stop being managed once DSH exits.
